notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.11 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.10

Nothing an office on Open Dental can see. This beta finishes Diastema's connection to NexHealth and the pieces for practices Diastema hosts on its own servers, which stay switched off for an office that uses Open Dental:

- A practice on NexHealth reads its system's phones, insurance amounts, claim dates, blockouts and holidays the way Open Dental shows them, and online booking works there.
- On NexHealth, online booking offers times on a step the practice sets (Settings → Online scheduling → Times offered every: 5, 10 or 15 minutes, 10 to start). An Open Dental office keeps Open Dental's own step and sees no new setting.
- A change to a booking that the practice's system hasn't taken yet waits on To the chart instead of being lost.
- A new NexHealth practice's first copy of its history no longer counts toward its daily call limit.
- A practice that Diastema hosts can now be set up on NexHealth from its setup file.

Before you switch

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.9 or beta.10: nothing to do; there is no database update in this beta.

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.1 through beta.8: a database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v51"). Keep that copy.

Coming from stable: see the 0.32.0-beta.2 notes. A database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v51"). Keep that copy.
